description:

Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Badgermole Cub.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Freed from the Real by paying its mana cost, attaching it to the earthbent land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Badgermole Cub's second ability triggers, adding {G}.

Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding two {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Birds of Paradise.

Once you have infinite blue mana, you may repeat for infinite colored mana.

Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding two {U}{U}.

Repeat.

When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Clever Impersonator. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Clever Impersonator that has haste. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter as a copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Put the oldest Kiki-Jiki into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat step 1 using the Clever Impersonator token instead.

Clever Impersonator enters as a copy of Sharuum.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator triggers, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Sharuum into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sharuum enters the battlefield triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.
Activate Clever Impersonator by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Clever Impersonator into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, Mystic Barrier and Clever Impersonator trigger, choosing "left" for Mystic Barrier and "right" for Clever Impersonator.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Clever Impersonator. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
Blazing Sunsteel and Clever Impersonator trigger.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to any target.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to the indestructible creature.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Clever Impersonator's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Clever Impersonator's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Clever Impersonator's first loyalty ability by adding 0 loyalty counters, dealing 3 damage to target creature and having that creature deal 1 or 2 damage to Clever Impersonator.
Clever Impersonator triggers but fails to transform.
You must repeat the last step in a mandatory loop, resulting in a game draw.

Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

description:
